about: The models the runner knows. Add one entry to add a model: `bench.py direct <name>` / `bench.py inside <name>` then use it, and `bench.py score` picks up its raw files (b_<name>_<set>.jsonl.gz directly, c_<name>_<set>.jsonl.gz inside solvi) and prints it under `label`. api: "chat" (default, an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint) or "systemone" (a decision model over the System One API; inside solvi it is a solvi.systemone decider). base_url and key_env are optional (default: OpenRouter's chat API, $OPENROUTER_API_KEY); extra is merged into every request (for a decision model on OpenRouter, the provider pin); direct_path: the path of a systemone model's direct requests (default /v1/systemone); price_in / price_out ($ per 1M tokens) are only a fallback for an endpoint that does not report usage.cost.
